writeup: Woot has a new GoSports 20 ft freestanding volleyball training net for $39.99. It is model VB-NET-BOW-20, a height-adjustable indoor and outdoor net with instant setup. GoSports sells that same 20-foot net directly for $159.99, and Epic Sports has it in stock at the same price, so this is about $120 less. Woot showed only 2 left with a limit of 10 per customer.
